items.title: Crocodile sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: A crocodile was spotted in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru on December 1, 2024, near the fishermen's shed, and a photograph was captured by K.U. Varghese.

items.title: Crocodile spotted at Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: An environmental lover, Vikas Gowda, saw a crocodile resting on the Kukkarahalli Lake bund on January 28, 2026. Signboards warn people about the presence of crocodiles in the lake.

items.title: Giant crocodile appears near Mysore lake
items.snippet_en: The Hindu reported a giant crocodile sighting on March 26, 2010, on the Kukkarahalli Lake bund towards the university side.

items.title: Crocodile found in Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: News18 Kannada reported a crocodile sighting in Kukkarahalli Lake on September 7, 2023.

items.title: Kukkarahalli Lake Crocodile
items.snippet_en: Signboards warn people about the presence of crocodiles in Kukkarahalli Lake.

outputs.notes_en: The claim states that two crocodiles were seen in Kukkarahalli Lake yesterday evening (October 7, 2026). While multiple sources confirm crocodile sightings in Kukkarahalli Lake, none of them report a sighting on October 7, 2026, or mention two crocodiles specifically for any single recent event. The sightings reported are on various dates between 2010 and 2026, but not the specific date claimed.
